start: Gym online with a gym code; member page of a member who does not use the app yet

steps.action: Tap 'Share app link' (WhatsApp mark on the button)
user_sees: WhatsApp opens in a new tab on this member's number
A message already typed with the app link and the gym code
must_not: The message sent without the person pressing send in WhatsApp
Another gym's code or another member's number

start: Member page of a member with the 'Using the app' pill (another kind of member)

user_sees: 'Hi <first name>!'
'Here is the MettleUp app link from <gym>, in case you need to install the app again or use a new phone.'
'Tap to get the app:' and the link
'Gym code: <CODE>'
must_not: Words that invite them as if they were new

steps.action: Turn the internet off and look at the button
user_sees: Greyed, with the needs-internet words
must_not: A tab that opens to an error page

steps.action: In a gym that is not online (no gym code), tap 'Share app link'
user_sees: 'Get the free MettleUp app from <gym> to track your workouts.'
'Tap to get the app:' and the plain app link
No gym code line
must_not: An empty 'Gym code:' line
A made-up code

steps.action: Tap it for a member whose mobile is not a real number
user_sees: WhatsApp opens with the message typed and no chat picked
must_not: A chat opened with a wrong number

start: Member page; the link was shared a minute ago

steps.action: Come back to the panel tab
user_sees: The member page as it was; the button can be tapped again
must_not: A mark that the link was sent when nobody pressed send
Anything saved about the member

steps.action: Tap 'Share app link' and read the typed message
user_sees: Only the member's first name, the gym name, the app link and the gym code
must_not: The member's mobile, dues or plan in the message
The message opened on any chat but this member
